question: In February 2020, the Indian Railways launched its first ‘Restaurant on Wheels’. The restaurant was inaugurated at the circulating area of the ______ Railway Station.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Asansol.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• On** February 26, 2020, the Indian Railways' Asansol Division **opened its first **'Restaurant on Wheels'** for train passengers and local residents.
 
• The Restaurant on Wheels debuted near Asansol's train station.
 
• The establishment is called** 'Chai Chun Tea Cafe' by the railways**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian Railways is **a statutory entity **that operates India's national railway system and is owned by the** Ministry of Railways,** Government of India.
 
• With a total route length **of 67,956 kilometres**, it administers the** world's fourth largest national railway system.**
